trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum trophy is earned by obtaining all 54 other trophies in GTA 6. This roadmap achievement signifies complete mastery of the game's diverse activities, story missions, and collectibles. Players working toward the Platinum should follow a roadmap that guides them through each category systematically, tracking progress as they unlock each requirement. View the roadmap to monitor your advancement toward this ultimate goal. Earn the remaining trophies across story, collectibles, activities, and online modes to claim the Platinum.

Use the in-game map to pinpoint fishing locations and reel in the required catches.
